events.text:
# FORENSIC V5 DIAGNOSTIC — Half B authored from forensic vantage
# Source authority: forensic_v5c_consolidation workspace
# Evidence basis: RTFA.v0.2026-04-28 + SEC.v4.5.2026-04-28 + SDG.v0.1.2026-04-28 +
#   SLR.v0.2026-04-28 + MMR.v0.2026-04-28 + system_evolution_lineage_ledger.v0.1 +
#   maestro_v0.md + mosaic_engine_v0.1.md
# Emission timestamp: 2026-05-20
# Pairs with: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml (staging Half A)
# Attachment intent: paste verbatim alongside substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml into each
#   v5 POC/WIP workspace for corrective-response regeneration.

forensic_window_identity:
  workspace: forensic_v5c_consolidation
  authority_basis: primary_corpus_audit_chain
  authority_scope: >
    Forensic-vantage diagnostic of v5 lineage attempts (v5, v5-b, v5-c) against the
    operational substrate floor emitted by staging in substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml.
    Authority is over v5 attempt analysis derived from primary corpus audit and
    edge confirmation. NOT over operational state enforcement (staging owns that)
    and NOT over future runtime selection (operator owns that).
  authority_disclaimer: >
    All forensic-chain edges remain CANDIDATE pending operator force-closure.
    Operator Decisions OD-1 through OD-5 are recommended but not bound.
    Morris Matrix sub-questions OQ-6.1, OQ-6.2, OQ-6.3 remain open.

complementary_to: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml

v5_attempts_observed:

  - attempt_id: v5
    what_v5_was_trying_to_build: >
      Multi-file modularization of the Maestro monolith. Each concern split into
      its own file (custom instructions, knowledge base, configuration, validators)
      to enable scaled governance and clean separation of responsibilities. The
      intent was sound by conventional software architecture standards.
    motivation_inferred: >
      Operator was hitting ChatGPT file/context limits and observing that the
      v4.5 monolith felt unwieldy. Field convention says modularize. v5 attempted
      to apply that convention.
    operational_substrate_v5_lacked:

- primitive_name: blueprint_json_as_single_source_of_truth
        v5_substitute_attempted: per-file UST with cross-references between files
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          Cross-file references require retrieval and inference across boundaries.
          The substrate's primary function is depth-accumulation across
          cross-references. Multi-file split broke the implicit co-residence that
          made depth-accumulation work. This is the across-boundary inference
          failure documented in RTFA.v0.

- primitive_name: sequential_workflow_enforcement
        v5_substitute_attempted: phase-order rules distributed across files
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          Phase ordering requires the full pipeline to be co-resident for the
          controller to gate progression. Split files cannot enforce ordering
          when the gating logic and the gated state live in different retrieval
          contexts.

- primitive_name: anti_summarization_governance
        v5_substitute_attempted: implicit; not articulated in v5
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          v5 actively summarized its own content to fit file boundaries — exactly
          the anti-pattern DC_10 later codified as forbidden.
      - primitive_name: suno_v4_5_strict_container_full_rule_set
        v5_substitute_attempted: container rules distributed across files
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          Container emission requires all rules co-resident at emit time.
          Distributed rules produce containers that pass per-file validation but
          fail composite validation.
    primitives_v5_did_carry_forward_correctly:

- "intent to scale governance discipline"
      - "intent to separate concerns"
      - "preservation of phase-based thinking even if mis-implemented"
    why_v5_failed_from_operational_vantage: >
      Hard failure on all surfaces. Multi-file split broke implicit cross-references.
      Per system_evolution_lineage_ledger, v5 status = exposes_failure. Per RTFA.v0:
      "the field's prevailing architectural advice [modularization] is wrong for
      this problem class." For systems whose primary function is depth-accumulation
      across cross-references, monolithic co-residence is the correct architecture;
      modularization is contraindicated.

- attempt_id: v5-b
    what_v5_was_trying_to_build: >
      Stopgap recovery from v5 failure. Same multi-file ambition with attempted
      patches to address the cross-reference breakage observed in v5.
    motivation_inferred: >
      Operator wanted to salvage the modularization investment without going back
      to monolith. v5-b tried to fix v5 within v5's architectural assumptions.
    operational_substrate_v5_lacked:

- primitive_name: same_as_v5
        v5_substitute_attempted: incremental patches to cross-reference handling
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          The root cause was the architectural choice itself, not implementation
          details. Patching cross-reference handling within multi-file architecture
          cannot resolve teleological collapse in inference across boundaries.
    primitives_v5_did_carry_forward_correctly: []
    why_v5_failed_from_operational_vantage: >
      Per system_evolution_lineage_ledger, v5-b status = exposes_failure (stopgap;
      same root cause). Same architecture, same failure mode, additional
      complexity without remediation.

- attempt_id: v5-c
    what_v5_was_trying_to_build: >
      Substrate rebuild as MOSAIC v2.2 / v2.3. Treated the failure of v5/v5-b as
      a diagnostic prompt to formalize the substrate itself. Introduced concepts
      including 4-Plane partition, 4-layer Persona Stack, K1-K6/K8 admissibility
      criteria, Air-Gapped Transfer Pack (ATP) for portability, Cross-Plane
      Feedback. v5-c was simultaneously a continuation of the v5 lineage and a
      meta-step attempting to escape it by formalizing what was missing.
    motivation_inferred: >
      Operator and v5-c authoring sessions recognized that the failure was
      substrate-level, not implementation-level. v5-c tried to specify the
      substrate explicitly so any future runtime could implement it without
      relying on implicit co-residence.
    operational_substrate_v5_lacked:

- primitive_name: blueprint_json_as_single_source_of_truth
        v5_substitute_attempted: 4-plane partition with Technical UST as canon plane
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          Technical UST as canon is sound (forensic chain confirms this). But
          v5-c lacked the operational instantiation — how Technical UST connects
          to Suno emission, how it connects to validation, how it lives at
          runtime. v5-c described the substrate but did not staff it.

- primitive_name: twelve_persona_operational_form
        v5_substitute_attempted: 4-layer Persona Stack as worker schema
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          Per SEC.v4.5 + OD-1, the v4.5 9-element flat worker schema is
          canonical; 4-layer Persona Stack is presentation grouping at best.
          v5-c treated the presentation layer as the operational layer.

- primitive_name: suno_v4_5_strict_container_full_rule_set
        v5_substitute_attempted: output contract layer as Plane 4 abstraction
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          Abstraction without rule preservation. The 6-11 syllable target, the
          comma policy, the metacontainer protocol, the lyric line order —
          these are operational primitives that survive abstraction only if
          carried forward literally. v5-c lost them.

- primitive_name: sacred_imperfection_doctrine
        v5_substitute_attempted: not present in v5-c
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          Sacred Imperfection is a doctrine that emerges from operator somatic
          truth (HPA) and cannot be derived from architecture alone. v5-c was
          architecture-first and the doctrine had no formal home.

- primitive_name: viral_5_overlay
        v5_substitute_attempted: not present in v5-c
        unfit_for_purpose_because: >
          VIRAL-5 is a strategic overlay that conditions every phase. v5-c's
          plane partition did not include strategic overlay as a distinct
          architectural element.
    primitives_v5_did_carry_forward_correctly:

- "Air-Gapped Transfer Pack (ATP) — packaging primitive — confirmed CANON in SDG.v0.1 E14b"
      - "Cross-Plane Feedback function — confirmed CANON in SDG.v0.1 E15a (structure pending OD-2)"
      - "Layer 5e Executive Committee Red-Pen Review concept (recovered as Morris Matrix in MMR.v0)"
      - "Framework Orchestrator 10-strategy selection (SDG.v0.1 E16)"

- "Mode A/B Detection (SDG.v0.1 E17)"
      - "Memory-Refine /prefs with TTL (SDG.v0.1 E18)"
      - "Sequential Departmental Processing → Round-Robin → LOCK ordering (SDG.v0.1 E20)"
    why_v5_failed_from_operational_vantage: >
      v5-c described the substrate without staffing it. Per RTFA.v0: "v5-c was a
      hard-failure diagnostic, not an almost-complete system. The substrate was
      implicitly carried in v4.5; v5-c lost critical primitives." The diagnostic
      value of v5-c is high — it surfaced primitives worth recovering. The
      operational value of v5-c standalone is low — it cannot be loaded as a
      runtime because it lacks the operational instantiation layer that
      substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml now provides explicitly.

operational_primitives_v5_lacked:
  # Cross-cutting list — primitives present in substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml that
  # were absent across the v5 lineage. References point to Half A locations.

  - primitive_name: blueprint_json_as_single_source_of_truth
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#active_governance_stack.blueprint_json
    v5_substitute_attempted: multi-file UST, then 4-plane partition canon
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

- primitive_name: suno_v4_5_strict_container_full_rule_set
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#active_governance_stack.suno_v4_5_strict_container
    v5_substitute_attempted: distributed rules / abstract output contract
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

  - primitive_name: anti_summarization_governance
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#delta_clusters_as_substrate_primitives.DC_10
    v5_substitute_attempted: none
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

- primitive_name: transcript_ingest_protocol
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#transcript_ingest_protocol_operational_form
    v5_substitute_attempted: none
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

  - primitive_name: sacred_imperfection_doctrine
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#active_governance_stack.sacred_imperfection_doctrine
    v5_substitute_attempted: none
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

- primitive_name: twelve_personas_in_operational_form
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#active_personas_operational_form
    v5_substitute_attempted: 4-layer Persona Stack (presentation only per OD-1)
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

  - primitive_name: viral_5_overlay
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#active_governance_stack.viral_5_overlay
    v5_substitute_attempted: none
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

- primitive_name: session_ledger_write_and_read_protocol
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#active_governance_stack.session_ledger
    v5_substitute_attempted: ledger named but not operationalized
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

  - primitive_name: sequential_workflow_enforcement
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#active_governance_stack.sequential_workflow_enforcement
    v5_substitute_attempted: phase rules distributed; ordering lost in multi-file split
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

- primitive_name: validation_system_VAL_QUINN_RapCouncil_HPA
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#validation_system_operational_form
    v5_substitute_attempted: Layer 5 admissibility abstracted without operational checks
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

  - primitive_name: hsi_protocol_origin_scar_choice_cost
    operational_location: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml#human_struggle_injection_protocol_operational_form
    v5_substitute_attempted: none
    operational_recommendation: preserve_in_v4.5_lineage

recoverable_into_operational_canon:
  # What of v5 lineage is worth carrying forward into v4.5.5+ or into Mosaic v0.1.

  - element_name: Air-Gapped_Transfer_Pack_ATP
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c MOSAIC v2.2
    operational_assessment: >
      Solves v4.5's portability gap ("information stuck in that GPT"). ATP =
      Triad + Technical UST + SEM Report + Review Transcript + Persona
      Participation Map + Manifest + Hash. Verifiable, resumable, auditable.
      Fits cleanly into substrate_floor session_ledger lineage as the
      session-end packaging primitive.
    pre_filing_sensitive: false

- element_name: Executive_Committee_Red-Pen_Review_Layer_5e
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c with Morris Matrix recovery via MMR.v0
    operational_assessment: >
      Final pre-LOCK gate where executive committee applies Q1-Q16 review
      questions to assembled draft technical.ust. Red-penned items return to
      lawful domain owners for revision. Adds rigor to staging's existing
      HPA + RapCouncil validation by introducing a committee-level final
      review with explicit red-pen disposition. Open: committee composition
      (OQ-6.1), Q1-Q16 schema content (OQ-6.2), K8 version collision (OQ-6.3).
    pre_filing_sensitive: true

- element_name: Sequential_Departmental_Processing_then_Round_Robin
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c + Day 3 documentation + operator correction
    operational_assessment: >
      Two-phase ordering: Phase 1 = sequential per-axis drafting by lawful SMEs
      within their domains; Phase 2 = interdepartmental round-robin and pressure.
      Refines staging's sequential_workflow_enforcement by explicitly separating
      per-axis drafting from cross-axis consensus.
    pre_filing_sensitive: false

- element_name: Framework_Orchestrator_10_strategy_selection
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c (recovered from v4.5 monolith §4.3)
    operational_assessment: >
      Strategy selector chooses how a worker reasons (10 strategies) independent
      of how workers orchestrate (4 modes). Operational form would add a strategy
      field to each worker invocation in substrate_floor.
    pre_filing_sensitive: false

- element_name: Mode_A_B_session_entry_detection
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c (recovered from v4.5 customInstructions and Suno KB §IV)
    operational_assessment: >
      Detection of cold-start (Mode A) vs warm-resume (Mode B) at session entry
      determines whether substrate must be reconstructed from ATP or whether
      session continues from in-memory state. Useful for session_ledger discipline.
    pre_filing_sensitive: false

- element_name: Memory_Refine_prefs_with_90_day_TTL
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c (recovered from Suno v4.5 KB §IV)
    operational_assessment: >
      Versioned reusable preferences with TTL aging. Distinct from in-session
      determinism — preferences expire if not reaffirmed. Complements
      substrate_floor's session_ledger by extending memory governance across
      sessions.
    pre_filing_sensitive: false

- element_name: Five_Implicit_Structuring_Tools
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c (recovered from Suno v4.5 KB §I.F)
    operational_assessment: >
      Fishbone, SWOT, Decision Trees, Virtual Whiteboards, Word Clusters — as
      named cognitive operators accessible to workers via skill_core. Trigger
      conditions per v4.5 §I.F. These were lost in v5-c emission but recovered
      as canon by SDG.v0.1 E19.
    pre_filing_sensitive: false

unfit_for_purpose:
  # What v5 produced that should explicitly NOT be carried forward.

  - element_name: multi_file_split_architecture
    source_v5_attempt: v5, v5-b
    operational_diagnosis: >
      Root cause of v5/v5-b failure. For systems whose primary function is
      depth-accumulation across cross-references, modularization is
      contraindicated. The architecture itself is unfit; no patches to it
      will resolve the across-boundary inference failure.
    risk_if_carried_forward: "regenerates teleological collapse; reproduces v5 failure mode"

- element_name: four_layer_Persona_Stack_as_operational_schema
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c
    operational_diagnosis: >
      Per OD-1 recommendation: 4-layer Persona Stack is presentation grouping,
      not operational schema. The v4.5 9-element flat worker schema (mission,
      decision_lens, do_rules, dont_rules, synergy_hooks, bounded_domain,
      bounded_non_domain, conflict_boundaries, persona_name) is operational.
      Treating presentation as operational degrades worker registration and
      runtime selection.
    risk_if_carried_forward: "workers fail registration; selection ambiguity at runtime"

- element_name: K1_K6_six_criterion_as_authoritative_SEM
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c MOSAIC v2.2
    operational_diagnosis: >
      Per maestro_v0.md §4.1 and operator CR-009: the v4.5 12-criterion weighted
      SEM (K1-K12) with 97.5% threshold is canonical, NOT the v5-c 6-criterion
      K1-K6. The 97.5% threshold is calibrated to operator somatic vagal/HPA
      activation, which the 70% default cannot honor.
    risk_if_carried_forward: "release-grade drift; sterile output passes admissibility"

- element_name: K8_slot_collision
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c v2.2 and v2.3
    operational_diagnosis: >
      K8 was named Compression survivability in v2.2 and Visual coherence in v2.3.
      Same slot, different criteria. Carrying either forward without resolution
      collides with the other. OQ-6.3 remains open.
    risk_if_carried_forward: "validation logic ambiguity; criterion drift across releases"

- element_name: v5_c_as_substrate_canon
    source_v5_attempt: v5-c
    operational_diagnosis: >
      v5-c is diagnostic, not canonical. Per RTFA.v0 + SEC.v4.5: v5-c was a
      hard-failure diagnostic that surfaced primitives worth recovering, but
      v5-c itself is not loadable as substrate. Promoting v5-c to canon would
      replay the failure mode that produced it.
    risk_if_carried_forward: "exposes_failure status forgotten; system regresses"

patch_001_relevance_to_v5_failures:
  # Patch-001 has not been executed. This analysis is forward-looking.

  - patch_001_section: "§1 Canon Load and Precedence"
    addresses_v5_failure: "v5's lack of explicit precedence ordering when multiple files contained competing rules"
    sufficient_or_partial: sufficient

- patch_001_section: "§3 Active Runtime Chain"

    sufficient_or_partial: sufficient

  - patch_001_section: "§4 Anti-Summarization Governance"
    addresses_v5_failure: "v5's compression behavior that broke depth-accumulation across cross-references"
    sufficient_or_partial: sufficient

- patch_001_section: "§5 Transcript Ingest Protocol"
    addresses_v5_failure: "v5-c's lack of operational protocol for ingesting prior dev session transcripts"
    sufficient_or_partial: sufficient

  - patch_001_section: "§6 Session Ledger Discipline"
    addresses_v5_failure: "v5-c's naming of ledger without operationalizing write and read protocols"
    sufficient_or_partial: sufficient

- patch_001_section: "§7 Persona Grammar Enforcement"
    addresses_v5_failure: "v5-c's loose persona handling; loss of strict grammar validation"

  - patch_001_section: "§9 Validation System"
    addresses_v5_failure: "v5-c's abstraction of admissibility without operational VAL/QUINN/RapCouncil/HPA checks"
    sufficient_or_partial: partial  # does not address K1-K12 vs K1-K6 collision; does not address K8 version collision; does not include Layer 5e Executive Committee Red-Pen Review

- patch_001_section: "§10 Human Struggle Injection"
    addresses_v5_failure: "v5-c's loss of HSI protocol"
    sufficient_or_partial: sufficient

  - patch_001_section: "§13 Patch Result"
    addresses_v5_failure: "absence of explicit composer-class stateful orchestration mode declaration"

cross_contamination_observed:

  - location: v5-c MOSAIC v2.2 / v2.3 framing
    confusion_type: Mosaic_material_treated_as_Maestro
    operational_correction: >
      Per operator correction ("Mosaic and Maestro are two different animals…
      cross contamination killed me"): Mosaic Engine is the substrate runtime
      (domain-neutral); Maestro is the music application mounted on Mosaic.
      v5-c conflated them by treating MOSAIC v2.2 as both substrate and
      application. substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml correctly keeps them separated:
      staging is Maestro application (PROJECT_MAESTRO scope), not Mosaic
      substrate. Mosaic Engine v0.1 + Maestro v0 in maestro_v0.md provides
      the clean separation: domain-neutral substrate (Mosaic) + music
      application mount (Maestro v0).

- location: 4_Plane_partition_as_Maestro_phase_model
    confusion_type: Mosaic_material_treated_as_Maestro
    operational_correction: >
      4-Plane partition (Plane 1 staffed runtime / Plane 2 canonical substrate
      state / Plane 3 admissibility runtime / Plane 4 external API) is Mosaic
      substrate architecture, not Maestro phase model. The Maestro phase model
      is the 13-stage chain in substrate_floor active_runtime_chain. v5-c
      treated 4-Plane as the Maestro phase model, displacing the operational
      13-stage chain. NS-3 still open: 4-Plane vs phase-based feedback structure.

- location: Persona_Stack_4_layer_as_canonical_worker_schema
    confusion_type: Mosaic_material_treated_as_Maestro
    operational_correction: >
      Per OD-1 recommendation: 4-layer Persona Stack is presentation grouping
      (potentially Mosaic-substrate-level); 9-element flat schema is Maestro
      operational schema. v5-c collapsed the levels and put the presentation
      layer into the operational schema slot.

completion_status:
  label: PROVISIONAL
  scope_satisfied: true  # for Half B (forensic diagnostic from forensic vantage)
  forensic_diagnostic_completeness: "substantial; bounded by remaining open OD-1 through OD-5 and OQ-6.1/6.2/6.3"
  unresolved_diagnostic_questions:
    - "OD-1: 4-layer Persona Stack disposition (recommendation: presentation only)"

- "OD-2: 4-Plane partition vs phase-based feedback (recommendation: function CANON, structure CANDIDATE)"
    - "OD-3: Strategy / Mode orthogonality (recommendation: keep orthogonal)"
    - "OD-4: Conversation Layer lineage (recommendation: Chimera-Indigo to Mosaic substrate canon)"
    - "OD-5: PTF library data structure (recommendation: YAML authored, JSON compiled)"

- "OQ-6.1: Executive Committee composition for 13-persona era"
    - "OQ-6.2: Q1-Q16 schema content"
    - "OQ-6.3: K8 slot collision (Compression survivability v2.2 vs Visual coherence v2.3)"
    - "NS-3: 4-Plane vs phase-based feedback structure selection"
    - "NS-4: substrate vs application boundary for Mode A/B and Memory-Refine"
  attachable_to_v5_workspaces: true
  pairs_with: substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml
  safe_to_use_downstream: true
  notes_for_synthesizer: >
    Half B of the substrate package. Forensic-vantage diagnostic of v5 lineage
    against operational substrate floor. Authority is forensic workspace,
    derived from primary corpus audit chain RTFA→SEC→SDG→SLR→MMR. Pairs with
    substrate_floor_v0.1.yaml (staging Half A). Together they constitute the
    full substrate package for attachment to v5 POC/WIP workspaces during
    corrective-response regeneration. All recommendations remain CANDIDATE
    pending operator force-closure on OD-1 through OD-5 and OQ-6.1/6.2/6.3.
